description: §42.2.4 — the canonical twin of condition/is-some-deprecated-expr: `x is given` in a value position, a compound condition and a parenthesized `if=` test. No W-IS-SOME-DEPRECATED; clicking #go sets @user, so @label = "present" (@n is 0) and #who renders — the same runtime as the deprecated spelling.
rationale: §42.2.4 — `expr is given` is THE explicit presence test, valid in a condition, a compound condition and every value position. §63.5 — the deprecated `is some` form's runtime is identical to this one. Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S460 "a′, go"; ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "a, validator too, go".
